title: Reuse a hosted projection
responsibility: Read a validated cached projection or load, validate and cache a replacement.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.projection
inputs.description: Profile name separating projection variants and accept callback that validates or converts candidate values.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.load
inputs.description: Asynchronous loader called when no usable cached projection exists.

outputs.name: hubProjectionCache
outputs.description: Accepted cached or newly loaded value. Cached JSON/validation failures delete the entry before loading; fresh values are accepted before serialization and storage.
